sector_proxy.method: leave-target-out equal-weight daily-rebalanced current-sector peers; exact observed dates; no forward fill; unofficial proxy, not an official sector index

selection: Development only: positive net trade expectancy, higher net portfolio return and daily Sharpe than baseline, drawdown no more than 105% of baseline, positive Bonferroni-adjusted block-bootstrap lower confidence bound for paired daily excess return, at least 30 development trades and >=5 in each of two contiguous development halves. Evaluate all predeclared variants, never select on full-period/test results.
adoption: Previously exposed last-30% period is a reused temporal holdout, not virgin out-of-sample evidence. No live adoption from it. Require at least 20 additional trades on post-registration unseen sessions plus stable positive risk-adjusted evidence; retain original until then.
quality: Freeze identical vendor inputs for every strategy comparison; exclude known quarantined bars. Source-recheck results are a separate audit and never retroactively change experiment data or authorize unverified closes.
limitations: Prior inspection of 25 trades includes the historical test period; its results are already known.
Current constituents and retrospective vendor adjustments create survivorship and corporate-action biases.
The sector basket is a proxy constructed from the current universe, not point-in-time official sector constituents.
Sample thresholds are conservative governance choices, not statistical guarantees.
